highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.3 fixes Uno 6.x WebAssembly linking with the Skia renderer on .NET 9 and later.

bullets.lead: Compatible WebGPU linker flags for Uno
bullets.detail: Uno 6.x WebAssembly apps using the Skia renderer no longer receive the conflicting -sUSE_WEBGPU flag on .NET 9 and later, where Dawn supplies WebGPU. The flag remains enabled for .NET 8, which still uses Emscripten's built-in WebGPU port.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Fixed the WebGPU linker-flag conflict for Uno WebAssembly apps on .NET 9 and later while preserving .NET 8 behavior.
